title: SPEAK UNLIMITED BLESSINGS INTO THE NEW MONTH
text: Beloved, before we go into this word and this prayer, I want you to do something for me right now. Share this with somebody. Share it with that friend who is standing at the threshold of a new month, not knowing what to carry into it. Share it with that brother, that sister, that family member who needs somebody to stand in the gap and speak life over their situation. You don't know who you are about to be a blessing to by simply pressing that share button. The word of God says that the generous soul will be made rich, and he who waters others will himself be watered. So, share this. Let it go. Let it reach that person who has been crying in the night, wondering if this month will be different. Let it reach that young man, that young woman who has worked hard but has not yet seen the fruit of their labor. Share it now and then come back because what God is about to do in this place, in this atmosphere is not ordinary. Now, come with me. Come with me into the presence of the Lord. I want you to understand something before I begin to speak. We are not gathering here for religious exercise. We are not here to go through motions. We are here because there is a God who sits upon the circle of the earth, whose breath is the wind, whose voice shakes the foundations of mountains. And that same God has something to say about your new month. He has something to say about your life. He is not silent. He is not passive. He is not watching from a distance with folded arms wondering what will happen to you. No, he is engaged. He is involved. He is present. And he has sent his word into this moment to perform surgery, to perform a turn around, to perform a supernatural upgrade that no human hand can undo. Psalm 65:11 says, "You crown the year with your goodness, and your paths drip with abundance." I want you to say that slowly in your spirit. His paths drip, not trickle, not occasionally produce, drip with abundance. [music] The imagery there is one of overflow. Of a God who does not portion out goodness in miserly amounts, but who saturates the atmosphere with his blessing wherever his presence passes through. And I'm telling you by the spirit of God that his presence is passing through your month right now. Right now. Even as you read these words or hear this message, something is shifting in the spiritual geography of your next 30 days. I need you to understand something foundational. Blessings are not accidents. Favor is not random. The word of God says in Proverbs 10:22, the blessing of the Lord, it maketh rich, and he addeth no sorrow with it. The blessing of the Lord, not the blessing of your hard work alone. Not the blessing of your cleverness. Not the blessing that comes merely from strategy and positioning, though all of those matter, but the blessing of the Lord. There is a specific blessing that carries the fingerprint of divinity. There is a specific blessing that when it touches your life, your colleagues cannot explain it. Your enemies cannot resist it. Your circumstances cannot contain it. And God is saying to you today that this month his specific blessing, the one with his name on it, the one that came out of his will and his counsel, is being released over your life. I want to preach to you about the power of the spoken word in the life of a believer. We have underestimated this. We have treated it casually. We have sometimes mistaken this for motivational speaking, for [music] positive thinking, for self-help psychology. But I want you to understand that what I'm talking about has deep roots in scripture. In the very beginning, God did not build the world, he spoke it. Genesis 1:3. And God said, "Let there be light." [music] And there was light. He said, he spoke, and the substance of reality bends to the authority of his voice. Now, here is what most people miss. You were made in his image. Genesis 1:26. And God said, "Let us make man in our image, after our likeness." You carry in you something of the speaking nature of God. You are not just a biological organism that processes food and produces labor. You are a speaking spirit. You are a voice. And when your voice is aligned with the voice of God, when what you say begins to echo what heaven says, there is a creative force that is unleashed in your life that cannot be stopped by the economy, cannot be stopped by your background, cannot be stopped by what has been happening for the past years. Job 22:28. One of the most powerful verses in all of scripture about this subject says, "You shall also decree a thing, and it shall be established for you, and light shall shine on your ways." Decree, not beg, not wish, not hope, decree. The word decree carries the weight of legal authority. It is what a judge does in a courtroom. [music] It is what a king does from his throne. And this verse is telling you a child of God, a joint heir with Christ, a royal priest according to 1 Peter 2:2-9, that you have the capacity to decree things into establishment, to take what God has already settled in heaven, and to enforce it on the earth by the authority of your mouth. This is not arrogance. This is not presumption. This is covenant. This is what it means to be in right standing with God. When you are righteous not by your own performance, but by the blood of Jesus. When you are standing in the position that Christ purchased for you, your words carry weight. Your declarations have consequences. Your decrees create realities. And the enemy knows this. The devil knows the power of the believer's mouth. That is why he has spent so much time training people to speak doubt, training people to rehearse failure, training people to keep saying nothing good ever happens to me, this is my portion. I have tried and tried. Because he understands that as long as he can keep your mouth aligned with his agenda, he can keep your life from experiencing what God intended. But today, we are breaking that pattern. Today, we are interrupting that cycle. The spirit of God is present in this moment to help you speak differently, to help you open your mouth and let something different come out. Something that smells like heaven. Something that carries the weight of eternity. Something that makes the angels stand at attention because they have been waiting for you to say it. Let me take you to Romans chapter 4 verse 17. It speaks about Abraham and says that God calls those things which do not exist as though they did. This is the nature of God. This is how God operates. He speaks to the not yet as though it is already. He addresses the invisible as though it is visible. He names what has not happened as though it has happened, and then what reality catches up with his declaration. Reality reorganizes itself to accommodate what God has spoken. And the same principle operates in the life of a believer who has learned to pray and declare according to the word of God. I want you to understand that entering a new month is not merely a calendar event. A new month is a spiritual threshold. A new month is a doorway. And what you carry through that doorway, what you speak as you cross that threshold, sets the tone for what unfolds on the other side. Many people cross into new months carelessly, they say nothing intentional, they declare nothing prophetic, they enter passively, and then they wonder why the same patterns keep repeating. But not you. [music] Not this time. Not after today. Isaiah 43:19 says, "Behold, I am doing a new thing. Now it springs forth. Do you not perceive it?" The question God asked is remarkable. Do you not perceive it? Because the new thing was already springing. It was already happening, but the issue was perception, the issue was awareness, the issue was whether the person would open their eyes and open their mouth and partner with what God was already doing. And today God is saying to you, perceive it, see it, align with it. Open your mouth and partner with what I am already doing in your life. Now, I want to go deeper. I want to talk to you about the three dimensions of speaking unlimited blessings. The first is prophetic alignment. There are things that God has already spoken over your life. There are prophecies both written in scripture and spoken by his spirit that hang over your life waiting for you to align with them. Jeremiah 29:11 says, "For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, says the Lord, thoughts of peace and not of evil, to give you a future and a hope." These are not vague sentiments, these are active intentions. These are living words that have been hanging in the heavenlies over your life from before the foundation of the world. And when you begin to declare them, when you open your mouth and say God's thoughts toward me are of peace and not of evil, I have a future. I have a hope. You are creating alignment between the earthly and the heavenly. You are essentially saying to God, I agree with your report. I align with your intention. I receive your counsel for my life. The second dimension is prophetic momentum. When you speak blessings consistently, when you do not just declare once and then forget, you create a momentum in the spirit realm. Proverbs 18:21 says, "Death and life are in the power of the tongue." The word power there in the Hebrew is yad, it means hand, the hand of the tongue. Life and death are handled by what you say. And when you keep handling life, when you keep picking up life and releasing it into your circumstances, you build a spiritual momentum that begins to attract and magnetize the blessings of God toward you. David understood this. David would say in Psalm 27:1, "The Lord is my light and my salvation, whom shall I fear? The Lord is the stronghold of my life, of whom shall I be afraid?" He was not just expressing emotion, he was building something. He was stacking declarations one on top of another and creating a fortress of faith that the enemy could not penetrate. The third dimension is prophetic displacement. [music] When you speak life, you are not just adding something, you are removing something. You are displacing darkness. You are displacing lack. You are displacing confusion and stagnation and limitation. Isaiah 54:17 says, "No weapon formed against you shall prosper, and every tongue that rises against you in judgment you shall condemn." This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord. Heritage, it is your inheritance. You do not have to pray for it, you have to receive it, activate it, and enforce it. And as you enter this new month, I am declaring to you that every weapon that was assembled in the previous months, every plan of the enemy, every assignment of darkness is being displaced by the word of God being released over your life right now. I want to speak to someone specifically. There is someone reading or hearing this right now who has been going through a season of prolonged waiting. You have been believing God for something for a long time. There have been moments when you almost let go. Moments when the logical thing to do seemed to be to lower your expectations and make peace with what appeared to be reality. But there was something in your spirit that would not let you completely release it. That something is the Holy Spirit. That resistance in your spirit was heaven refusing to let you abandon the promise. God is saying to you today, "Hold on." Not just emotionally, not just psychologically, but strategically. Open your mouth and declare that what God has promised has not expired. Declare that his word has a long shelf life. Declare that what he spoke in the secret place is being made manifest in this new month. Habakkuk 2:3 says, "For the vision is yet for an appointed time. Though it tarries, wait for it because it will surely come. It will not tarry. It will surely come." That word surely is God's personal guarantee. He is not saying it might come. He is not saying there is a possibility. He is saying it will surely come. And today your declaration partners with that guarantee and activates the timing of heaven over your situation. Let me speak to another person. There is someone here who has been dealing with financial pressure. The numbers have not been adding up. The needs have been outpacing the resources. And there has been a weariness, a fatigue that comes not just from the situation, but from the emotional weight of carrying it. [music] I want you to know first that God sees it. He has not been absent. He has not been unmoved. He knows every figure. He knows every debt. He knows every sleepless night that was spent calculating and recalculating. And he says to you today, Philippians 4:19, "My God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus. Not according to the economy. Not according to your current earning capacity. According to his riches in glory." That is a different accounting system. That is a heavenly economy that operates by different laws, different principles, and different outcomes. And as you speak this month, as you declare [music] supply, as you declare abundance, as you open your mouth and say, "I am not a debtor. I am a lender. I am not the tail. I am the head." You are making a withdrawal from that heavenly account. You are reaching through the veil and pulling into the earthly realm what already exists in the eternal. Deuteronomy 28:12 says, "The Lord will open to you his good treasure, the heavens, to give rain to your land in its season, and to bless all the work of your hand." All the work of your hand. Not some of it. Not the work that looks impressive, all of it. God is interested in blessing your hand, your effort, your creativity, your labor, your ideas. And this month, I am declaring that the hand of God rests upon the work of your hand. That what you touch prospers. That what you build stands. That what you plant yields harvest. That what you sow comes back to you multiplied beyond what you imagined when you first released it. Now, I want to lead you in prayer. And I want you to understand that what we are about to do is not recitation. This is not religious liturgy. This is warfare. This is governmental intercession. This is a king and a priest standing at the gate of a new month and making legal declarations that the forces of darkness must recognize. So, do not be passive. Do not allow your mind to wander. Come fully into this. Let your spirit be engaged. Let your voice be raised if you can raise it. Let your faith be active. And let us together speak unlimited blessings into this new month with every fiber of what we are. Father, in the name of Jesus, I come before your throne, not the throne of judgment, but the throne of grace. And I come with boldness as Hebrews 4:16 commands me. I come with confidence because I am not coming in my own righteousness, >> [music] >> but in the righteousness that Jesus purchased for me on the cross. I am covered. I am cleansed. I am accepted in the beloved according to Ephesians 1:2-6. And from this position of acceptance and sonship, I open my mouth now to make declarations over this new month. I declare that this month is not ordinary. This month carries a divine assignment. This month has been marked by heaven for unusual and unprecedented blessing. I decree by the authority of the word of God that every good thing that the enemy delayed in previous months is being released with compound interest in this month. God, your word says that you restore the years that the locust has eaten. Joel 2:25, and I receive that restoration now. I receive it with my whole heart. I receive it with my voice. I receive it with my expectation. What was lost is returning. What was stolen is being recovered. What was delayed is being accelerated. I receive it. I receive it. I receive it. Father, I speak over my finances in this new month. I declare that I'm a lender and not a borrower. Deuteronomy 28:12 is alive and active in my life. The Lord opens to me his good treasure [music] and blesses the work of my hands. Every door of financial opportunity that was closed is being opened. Every channel of supply that was blocked is being unblocked [music] by the spirit of God right now. I speak to every mountain of financial pressure and I say be removed and be cast into the sea. Mark 11:23 is my portion. I speak to lack and I say your time in my life is over. Your assignment is canceled. Your lease has expired. I am a child of the most high God and lack has no covenant with me. Abundance has a covenant with me. Prosperity has a covenant with me. The blessing of the Lord that maketh rich and adds no sorrow, that blessing is my portion in this month in the name of Jesus. I decree open doors in this new month. Isaiah 22:22, what God opens no man can shut. I receive open doors of opportunity, open doors of divine connection, open doors of favor that I did not earn and could not have manufactured. Father, your word says in Psalm 5:12 that you bless the righteous and surround them with favor as with a shield. I receive that shield of favor. I declare that everywhere I go this month favor goes before me. Into every meeting favor enters first. Into every negotiation favor is present. Into every application, every proposal, every transaction favor is there like a forerunner preparing the way for me to walk in blessing. I declare divine health over my body. 3 John 1:2 as my soul prospers, I prosper and I am in health. My body is the temple of the Holy Spirit according to 1 Corinthians 6:19 and the spirit of God who raised Jesus from the dead. Romans 8:11 says he quickens and gives life to my mortal body. I declare life in my blood. I declare health in my bones. I declare clarity in my mind. Every assignment of infirmity against my body is nullified by the blood of Jesus. Every spirit of sickness that thought it had a door into my life this month is evicted right now in the name that is above every other name. By his stripes I was healed. That healing is not future. It was accomplished on the cross and I am walking in the reality of it in this new month. Father, I speak over my relationships in this new month. I speak peace over my home. I speak unity over my family. I speak supernatural love, the agape love of God into every relationship that has been strained. Every wall of misunderstanding that the enemy built between me and my blessing connections is coming down right now. I will meet the right people in this month. I will be connected to the right mentors, the right partners, the right collaborators. Divine connections are being orchestrated by the spirit of God, and I declare that I will not miss them. My eyes are open. My heart is open. My spirit is sensitive to the leading of the Holy Spirit, and I will recognize every God appointment that comes to me in this month. I speak over my purpose [music] in this new month. I declare clarity. I declare acceleration. I declare that every a assignment of confusion over my destiny is destroyed by the fire of the Holy Ghost. God has not given me a spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind. 2 Timothy 1:2-7. A sound mind means a mind that knows who it is, knows where it is going, knows what it is carrying, and knows how to function in alignment with God's will. I have a sound mind. I have clear direction. I have divine wisdom for every decision I need to make in this month. James 1:2-5. If anyone lacks wisdom, let him ask of God who gives generously and without reproach. I am asking. And I'm receiving. Wisdom is mine. Strategy is mine. Creative ideas are mine. Supernatural solutions are mine. In the name of Jesus. Now I want to wage war. I want to go militant. Father, I take authority in this new month over every assignment of the enemy. Every plan, every scheme, every device that was designed against me, I render it null and void by the blood of Jesus and the word of God. Isaiah 54:2-17. No weapon formed against me shall prosper. I do not just believe that, I declare it. I enforce it. I activate it. Every weapon, financial weapons, weapons of job loss, of business failure, of unexpected expenses designed to wipe out my progress, they shall not [music] prosper. Health weapons, weapons of disease, of accident, of sudden tragedy, they shall not prosper. Relational weapons, weapons of betrayal, of abandonment, of toxic connections, they shall not prosper. Every tongue that rises against me in judgment, I condemn it. This is my heritage. This is my covenant right. And I am enforcing it right now in the name of Jesus. I speak to every spirit of stagnation that has been operating of my life. I pull it out [music] by the roots in the name of Jesus. Spirit of delay, your time is up. Spirit of frustration, your assignment is cancelled. Spirit of almost but not quite, that spirit that keeps bringing me close to breakthrough and then moving the goal post, you are exposed and you are evicted right now by the power of the Holy Ghost. I am not the person who almost makes it. I am the person who enters in. I cross over. I receive the fullness. I am not Moses who saw the promised land from a distance. I am Joshua who went in and possessed it. I possess my possessions this month. Obadiah verse 17, upon Mount Zion shall be deliverance. And there shall be holiness. And the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions. I possess my possessions. I possess every promise. I possess every territory God assigned to me. I possess [music] it in Jesus name. Father, I declare supernatural speed over my life in this new month. The God who can make a way in the sea and a path in the mighty waters, Isaiah 43:2-16, is making a way for me right now. Where there was no way, there is now a way. Where the path was blocked, it is now open. Where the road seemed to end, God is building a new road. The God of suddenly is at work in my life. Acts 16:26, suddenly there was a great earthquake and the foundations of the prison were shaken and all the doors were opened. I receive my suddenly. I receive my suddenly this month. Something is about to shift so dramatically, so unexpectedly, so powerfully that the only explanation will be the hand of God and I will stand and testify. I will stand and give glory. I will tell the story of what God did in this month because it will be so clearly his handywork. I speak to every situation in my life that has been lingering too long. Every Lazarus situation, situations that have been dead so long that people have began to say by this time there is a stench. I declare the word of Jesus over it, Lazarus, come forth. John 11:43. What has been dead in my life is being resurrected. Dead dreams are breathing again. Dead visions are coming back to life. Dead relationships that God intends to restore are being [music] revived. Dead opportunities that seem to have passed are being brought back around because with God [music] nothing is too hard. Jeremiah 32:27. I am the Lord, the God of all flesh. Is there anything too hard [music] for me? The answer is no. Absolutely nothing is too hard [music] for God. And in this new month, I am giving him the hard things. I am releasing to him the things I could not figure out. I am handing over the situations I could not solve and I am declaring that his supernatural power is being made perfect in my weakness and his solutions are arriving in this month. Father, I thank you. I want to end this prayer with Thanksgiving because Thanksgiving is faith made audible. Thanksgiving is not waiting to see it before you appreciate it. Thanksgiving is appreciating it before you see it because you know who gave it. Philippians 4:6 says, be anxious for nothing, but in everything by prayer and supplication with Thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God with Thanksgiving. I thank you for this new month. I thank you for the blessings that are already in transit. I thank you for the open doors that have been unlocked right now. I thank you for the healing that is flowing through bodies. I thank you for the financial turnarounds that have been engineered in the heavenlies. I thank you for the divine connections that have been aligned. I thank you for the peace that passes all understanding. Philippians 4:7 that is guiding my heart and mind through Christ Jesus. >> [music] >> I thank you that the best is not behind me. I thank you that what I have seen so far is a prelude. I thank you that you are a God who saves the best wine for last John 2:10 and this season is my last wine season. The best of what you have for me is coming. The fullness of your blessing is arriving and I receive it. I embrace it. I celebrate it in advance in the name of Jesus. I want to speak a prophetic word over you before I close. I see promotion. I see an elevation that is coming so suddenly that you will not even have time to prepare for it. Emotionally, you will just have to step into it. I see provision breaking out in places you did not expect. I see a phone call that is coming with good news in it. I see a door opening in a field where doors had previously been closed to [music] you. I see healing, physical healing for someone whose body has been under serious attack. I see the word of God going into your body like fire and consuming that thing that the doctors have been worried about. I see clarity for someone who has been confused about direction. The fog is lifting. The confusion is clearing and you are going to see your path so clearly in this new month that you are going to marvel at how you could not see it before. I see this month as a month of multiplication. Not just addition multiplication. Things will not just improve by small increments. They will multiply. What God does in this month will defy the mathematics of your situation. You will look at what you started with and look at what you end with and the difference will not make logical sense and that is the point. That is the signature of God on your story. When the increase cannot be explained by the input, that is a miracle. That is the blessing of the Lord operating without ceiling and without limit and I declare that this is your month for that. This is your month for miraculous multiplication. I want you to go into this month speaking. Do not be silent. Do not let days pass without you opening your mouth and making declarations over your life, your family, your business, your ministry, your health, your future. Every morning is a legislative session. When you wake up in the morning, the courts of heaven are open and you have access to that courtroom because of the blood of Jesus. Use that access. Stand up and say, "This is what I declare today. This is what I receive today. This is what I refuse today." Speak to your mountain every single day. Jesus did not say speak to your mountain once and then wait quietly. He said, "Whoever speaks to this mountain and does not doubt in his heart." Mark 11:23, consistent faith-filled speech that does not waver. That is the pattern. And as you maintain that pattern through this month, you will see things move, you will see things shift, you will see impossibilities becoming testimonies. Remember that the enemy wants your mouth. He wants you frustrated. He wants you confused. He wants you speaking defeat because he knows what a believing, spirit-filled believer with an open mouth can do. You can alter atmospheres. You can change environments. You can reverse verdicts. You can write new stories and God is equipping you with his word and his spirit to do exactly that in this new month. So, go. Go into this month like a king. Go into this month like a priest. Go into this month with your chin up and your mouth open and your faith [music] engaged. Go into this month knowing that the God of heaven has gone before you. That his angels have been given charge over you. That his favor is your shield. That his word is your weapon and that his love is your foundation. Nothing that comes against you can ultimately prevail. Nothing that the enemy builds can stand when the Lord himself is your fortress. Psalm 46:1. God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble. Very present. Not distant. Not delayed. Present. Right here. Right now. In this month. With you. For you. Working [music] all things together for your good according to Romans 8:28. All things. Not some things. The painful things, the confusing things, the things you cannot understand, they are all being woven together by a master weaver into a tapestry of glory that will tell the story of God's faithfulness in your life. Go and speak. Go and declare. Go and possess. This month belongs to you. Go take it in Jesus' mighty name.
